subject: HorizonDX — MAP-embedded go-live choreography & first-cut timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizondx.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: HorizonDX — MAP-embedded go-live choreography & first-cut timeline

Hi Elena —

Great to be moving this to the implementation phase. Attached is a first-cut MAP (mutual action plan) that embeds the post-signature go-live choreography: rollout phases, proposed canary windows, migration approach, and the training syllabus. High-level ask: please confirm preferred blackout weeks and any procurement/legal gating items we should pull into the MAP.

Key items in the attached MAP_v1:
- Phase 0 (Pre-launch): provisioning, IP allowlists, KMS onboarding (Dec 15–Dec 22)
- Phase 1 (Pilot / Canary): 1-week canary with 10% traffic to Redwood Dedicated; plan: Jan 20–Jan 26, contingency rollback policy included
- Phase 2 (Migration): data sync and cutover weekend (Feb 4–6) with cutover checklist and feature flags
- Phase 3 (Scale): scaled traffic ramp, performance evals, and quality baselining (Feb 7–Feb 28)
- Training: two half-day sessions for platform and engineering teams + one train-the-trainer for ops (target week Jan 9–13)

Acceptance criteria and evals embedded in the MAP: throughput and p95 latency thresholds, quality guardrails tied to our eval harness, and rollback triggers.

Attachments: HorizonDX_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones), HorizonDX_Migration_Runbook_v1.pdf (runbook stub), training_agenda-2027-01-12.docx (proposed trainer agenda).

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the blackout period for any production changes in January?
2) Also call out any legal/procurement dates we should reflect in the MAP.
3) If the training week looks tight, we can shift the canary 1 week later — want to align on your team’s availability.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

[Attachment: HorizonDX_Migration_Runbook_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@horizondx.com>

Date: 2026-12-05T12:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: HorizonDX — MAP-embedded go-live choreography & first-cut timeline

Thanks Karthik — this is very helpful. Quick notes from my side:
- We have a mandatory company-wide freeze the week of Jan 9 for fiscal close activities, so the training that week won't work for our engineering leads. Can you move training to the week of Jan 16?
- The procurement team needs final SOW and a confirmed license table by Dec 20 to process the PO.
- Legal wants to review the rollback SLA language in the MAP; looping them here.

If we can adjust training to Jan 16–20 and keep the canary the week after (Jan 23–29), that should give us breathing room. Also can you include an abbreviated escalation contact list (pager + backup) in the runbook?

Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Ops, HorizonDX
elena.morales@horizondx.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Subject: Re: HorizonDX — MAP-embedded go-live choreography & first-cut timeline

Elena —

Thanks for the quick read and the constraints. Updated plan below based on your notes (and I updated the attached MAP_v1 to reflect these):
- Training moved to Jan 16–20 (two half-day sessions + one train-the-trainer on Jan 18)
- Canary moved to Jan 23–29 (1-week, 10% traffic; rollback window: first 48 hours only)
- Migration weekend shifted to Feb 11–13 to avoid your Jan fiscal close and give us one extra validation week after canary
- SOW / license table: Laura is pulling the final line-item license table and SOW; we will deliver to procurement by Dec 18 to meet your Dec 20 PO deadline
- Runbook: we added escalation contacts (primary on-call: ops.horizondx@example.com; Redwood primary: pager+1) in Migration_Runbook_v1; will expand to include secondary backups

Related links: HubSpot record and DocuSign stub included below.

If that aligns I’ll mark the MAP as "agreed in principle" and ask legal to confirm rollback SLA language offline. Happy to do a 20-min review call Friday.

—Karthik

Acknowledged. Procurement deliverables are on track: I’ll send the finalized license table and SOW draft by EOD Dec 17 for your review. Monica and I will also run a quick dry-run of the canary checklist internally on Jan 18 to validate monitoring hooks and rollback automation.

Monica: please ensure runbooks include the CI/CD flag names and the exact metric thresholds for the p95 latency gate (we'll use the same eval IDs we capture in Redwood Optimize).

I’ll update the HubSpot stage to "Implementation - MAP agreed" after I receive your confirmation in the thread.
